address: Shop A, 7F, Lee Theatre Plaza, 99 Percival Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The original restaurant was founded in Singapore in 2000 and named after a coastal city in Fujian province – the owner’s hometown. This branch comes with an easy-going atmosphere and its Fujian cuisine is respectful of tradition, with a focus on natural flavours. New items are added to the menu from time to time. Don’t miss their themed offerings that feature a particular seasonal seafood, such as razor clams or oysters....
